final_result.reason: result completion ends at the validated record

union_seconds.basis: wall time covered by any wrapped focused test, counted once
wall time covered by any wrapped forge fetch, counted once
union_seconds.reason: no wrapped command of this kind was recorded; unknown, not zero

commands.note: only commands run through run_events.py wrap are recorded; overlapping intervals count once and are never summed as elapsed time

union_seconds.basis: wall time covered by any wrapped forge write, counted once; a wrapped loop is one interval whose result file records each write; not complete publication
union_seconds.reason: no wrapped command of this kind was recorded; unknown, not zero

context_to_validated_payload.basis: context build exit to validated payload exit: inspection, tests, verification, reconciliation and composition together; not separable

last_accounting_to_validated_payload.basis: last verifier accounting to validated payload: reconciliation, remaining falsification and composition
last_accounting_to_validated_payload.reason: no accounting precedes a validated payload

observed_span.basis: first recorded script or wrapped command start to last exit; excludes root dispatch, so not root elapsed

caller_mode.reason: one-shot or session mode is not passed to any script

not_observed.caller_mode: one-shot or session mode is not passed to any script
not_observed.collection: only forge fetches run through run_events.py wrap are timed; packet normalization and any unwrapped fetch record no event
not_observed.focused_tests: only focused tests run through run_events.py wrap are timed; verifier tests are never wrapped
not_observed.primary_idle_wait: the primary may keep working while a batch runs, so no bracket measures waiting
not_observed.primary_inspection: inspection and falsification run in the model between script calls
not_observed.publication: wrapped forge writes are timed one command or loop at a time, but no event proves every required write and readback finished; complete-publication timing needs caller or runtime evidence
not_observed.root_dispatch: the caller dispatches the review before any script runs
not_observed.usage: no script observes an authoritative per-request usage record
not_observed.verifier_dispatch_and_join: the worker is dispatched after the brief is built and joined before accounting; only those two script boundaries are recorded

usage.reason: no script observes an authoritative per-request usage record

bracket_sum_seconds.basis: sum of batch brackets; overlapping brackets count twice; not elapsed

bracket_union_seconds.basis: wall time covered by any batch bracket, counted once

verification.note: zero recorded batches is not proof that none ran unless the record is otherwise complete
